Based on the provided authoritative legal context for the Financial Year 2024-25, the standard deduction for salaried individuals under the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC) is **Rs. 75,000**.

**Legal Analysis:**

*   **Standard Deduction Limit:** The validation rules for the Income Tax Return explicitly state that in the case of the New Tax Regime, a taxpayer who is an employee can claim the standard deduction under Section 16(ia) only to the extent of **Rs. 75,000** [C4].
*   **Regime Specificity:** This limit is distinct from the Old Tax Regime, where different deduction rules apply (such as specific limits on family pension deductions under Section 57(iia)) [C1]. The Rs. 75,000 limit is specifically tied to the election of the New Tax Regime under Section 115BAC [C4].
